source.title: 969% Return in 1 Year: The Winning Pullback Strategy of a Trading Champion
source.speaker: Martin Luk (US Investing Championship 2025)

study.universe: 500 NSE symbols from the repository candle store; 485 with >=260 bars
known_biases: survivorship: today's index membership applied to the whole history
no corporate-action adjustment table in the candle store
impact cost not modelled beyond flat slippage

run_A_literal_stop_rule.note: stop <= min(5%, 0.5 x ADR20) - rule R-4 applied literally

run_B_ceiling_only.note: stop <= 5% only; the ADR half-range cap rejects 95.9% of triggers on daily bars

out_of_sample_signal_level.reading: flat signal, still loses as a portfolio once costs and the trailing exit are applied

blocking_defects.detail: The entry trigger (C-1..C-5), the stop (R-1..R-3) and the no-chase rule (N-1) are all intraday in the source. On daily bars the stop must risk a whole day's range, so the R-multiple denominator is roughly double the speaker's, and the observed average win is 1.67 R where his geometry implies 10-30 R.

R-1 (stop at the low of day) and R-4 (stop <= 50% of ADR) are compatible intraday and contradictory on daily bars: median required stop 3.40% against a median cap of 1.73%, rejecting 4,123 of 4,301 triggered signals. The survivors are the narrowest setup bars and 49% of them stop out on the entry bar.
blocking_defects.fix: no daily-bar fix exists; both readings are reported instead

blocking_defects.detail: Universe is today's membership applied backwards; demoted names absent. Inherited from the candle store, same defect the earlier audit recorded.
blocking_defects.fix: store membership with effective dates from today forward

blocking_defects.detail: Rule U-2 (trade names inside a hot theme) is untestable and unimplemented. It is one of the speaker's primary selection criteria.

stock_filters.rule: ema9 > ema21 > ema50 AND ema21[t] > ema21[t-5]
w_ema9 > w_ema21 AND w_close > w_ema9 (completed weeks only)
swing_low > swing_low_prev (3-bar fractals, published 3 bars late)

setup_conditions.rule: low <= L*1.005 AND close >= L*0.995 for at least one level L
setup_conditions.note: removing the pullback requirement entirely improves the result

confluence.definition: count of the seven levels touched on the same bar
confluence.video_claim: more levels lining up = higher probability (rule P-3, the central claim of the source)

stop_loss.gap_handling: fill at the open when the open is through the stop
stop_loss.intrabar_assumption: adverse - the stop is assumed hit before any target
stop_loss.note: tightening the ceiling makes results worse, inverting the source's central argument

target.note: the video has no price target; none was invented

position_sizing.note: the speaker runs up to 280% gross; the base run uses none, since Indian cash equities settle differently

exits.rule: close the remainder on the first daily close below the 9 EMA
exits.note: the single most valuable rule measured, and still trivial against the deficit

confirmation_factors.factor: close in the top third of the range

ranking_factors.factor: turnover percentile within the passing set
range contraction vs the last 10 bars

signal_score.ui_caption: Score orders candidates within this strategy. It is not a probability of profit. Measured expectancy on 2024-2026 Indian daily data: -0.32 R per trade.

required_data_before_retest: 5-minute intraday bars for the traded universe
a real index series (Nifty 500 / Nifty Midcap)
point-in-time index membership with effective dates

recommendation.reason: a signal with t = -13.18 negative expectancy does not need a forward test to disambiguate it

reusable_findings.finding: ADR is the strongest single ranking variable found in the sweep
reusable_findings.evidence: avg R -0.178 at ADR>=4% against -0.318 at ADR>=2%, monotonic across the sweep
reusable_findings.next_step: test as a universe filter for the existing S1-S4

reusable_findings.finding: the equal-weighted proxy index and breadth series are point-in-time and reusable
reusable_findings.evidence: research/pullback/features.py :: build_market, passes the truncation test
reusable_findings.next_step: fill the nifty_trend / market_breadth placeholders that core.py has carried as None since Phase 2b
